definitions.gloss: new film; new movie; latest release
definitions.explanation: A recently produced or newly released film. Used to distinguish newly made movies from older or classic ones.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}に{新作映画|しんさくえいが}を{観|み}に{行|い}こう。
examples.english: Let's go see a new movie this weekend.

examples.japanese: あの{監督|かんとく}の{新作映画|しんさくえいが}が{来月|らいげつ}{公開|こうかい}される。
examples.english: That director's new film will be released next month.

examples.japanese: この{映画館|えいがかん}では{新作映画|しんさくえいが}だけでなく、{名作|めいさく}の{再上映|さいじょうえい}も{行|おこな}っている。
examples.english: This theater not only shows new films but also re-screens classic works.

notes:
A compound of {新作|しんさく} (new work, new production) and {映画|えいが} (movie, film). A straightforward and frequently used term in entertainment media, movie listings, and everyday conversation about going to the cinema.

The {新作|しんさく} element can be combined with other media types: {新作|しんさく}ゲーム (new game), {新作|しんさく}アニメ (new anime), {新作|しんさく}ドラマ (new drama).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新作映画|しんさくえいが}の{予告|よこく}: trailer for a new film
- {新作映画|しんさくえいが}が{公開|こうかい}される: a new film is released
- {新作映画|しんさくえいが}を{観|み}る: to watch a new movie
- {話題|わだい}の{新作映画|しんさくえいが}: a much-discussed new film

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最新作|さいしんさく}: the latest work — emphasizes it being the very newest production
- {公開中|こうかいちゅう}の{映画|えいが}: currently showing film — focuses on current availability rather than newness
- {旧作|きゅうさく}: older work — the opposite, referring to older productions
